notes.title: Spooktober Update
notes.content:
Happy Spooktober! 

It’s the perfect time for us to release our biggest and spookiest update to Uncle Nook’s Monster Emporium! Check out the list of updates below, and we hope to see you soon in the emporium.

[h2]General[/h2]

[list]
[*] Controller support and button mapping settings page.
[*] Cameras no longer deal damage and instead stun enemies.
[*] Added new gun weapon types.  Guns deal damage to enemies.
[*] 6 new rooms have been added to the emporium.
[/list]

[h2]New Weapons[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304151/4b663063b61e63e36f59ad086c929746abd7d000.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Pistol - Semi automatic handgun. Uses bullets.
[*] Musket - Single shot rifle. Uses bullets.
[*] Laser - Deals damage over time. Overheats easily.
[*] Blunderbuss - Close quarters shotgun. Uses bullets.
[*] Thompson - Fully automatic machine gun. Uses bullets.
[/list]

[h2]New Monsters[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304151/01eccd5293dcd194477139bc2a536508f3ce9ea2.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Skeleton - Teleports randomly.
[*] Robot - Shoots cannonballs from its chest.
[*] Knight - Blocks damage and stuns with shield.
[*] Ghost - Turns ephemeral and becomes immune to damage and stuns
[*] Zombie - Can attack without a body. Aim for the head.
[/list]
